video_prompts.title: Messenger Overload — Stop Losing Customers to Slow Replies
video_prompts.business_problem: Too busy to reply to Messenger / WhatsApp — customers lose interest and go to competitors

scenes.visual: Close-up of a business owner's phone screen. Messenger and WhatsApp notifications are piling up — 47 unread messages. The owner is on a call, stressed, glancing at the phone. Red notification badges pulse. A customer message reads 'Hello? Are you still there?' with 'Seen 3 hours ago' below it.
scenes.text_overlay: Your customers are waiting...

scenes.visual: Split screen — left side shows a frustrated customer closing the chat and opening a competitor's page. Right side shows another customer typing 'I'll just go somewhere else.' Messages going unanswered.
scenes.text_overlay: And they won't wait forever.

scenes.visual: Smooth transition: the chaotic phone screen dissolves into a clean AI chatbot dashboard. The bot is auto-responding to every message instantly — greeting customers, answering product questions, booking appointments, sending product catalogs. Conversation bubbles flowing smoothly. A notification pops up: 'New appointment booked — Sarah K. — Tomorrow 2:00 PM'
scenes.text_overlay: AI responds instantly. 24/7. On every platform.

scenes.visual: Analytics dashboard zooming in: Lead capture rate jumps from 12% to 38%. A counter animates: '3x more leads captured this month.' The owner is now relaxed, reviewing the dashboard with a coffee, smiling.
scenes.text_overlay: 3x Lead Capture. Zero Missed Messages.

scenes.visual: Cloud Insider logo with tagline on dark background. CTA button glows.
scenes.text_overlay:
Never lose a customer to slow replies again.
Cloud Insider — We Build What Lasts.

video_prompts.title: Social Media Burnout — Your Brand Stays Active While You Rest
video_prompts.business_problem: Manually posting on social media every day — wasting hours with inconsistent results

scenes.visual: A frustrated entrepreneur staring at a blank content calendar at 11:47 PM. Multiple browser tabs open — Canva, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn. Empty posting queue. A sticky note on the monitor reads 'POST SOMETHING TODAY!!!' The clock ticks. Nothing gets posted.
scenes.text_overlay: Another day. No posts. No engagement.

scenes.visual: Time-lapse of competitor social pages thriving — likes, comments, shares flooding in. Meanwhile, the owner's business page shows 'Last posted: 12 days ago.' Follower count stagnating. A notification: 'Your page reach dropped 67% this month.'
scenes.text_overlay: Your competitors aren't sleeping. Your brand is.

scenes.visual: Clean transition to an AI content dashboard. The system auto-generates 30 days of branded social media content — captions, hashtags, images — tailored to the business. Calendar fills up automatically. Posts scheduled across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok. A preview shows: Monday 9 AM — Product Showcase. Tuesday 12 PM — Customer Testimonial. Wednesday 6 PM — Behind the Scenes.
scenes.text_overlay: AI generates 30 days of content. Automatically.

scenes.visual: The owner sipping coffee in the morning while posts go live automatically. Phone buzzes with engagement notifications — likes, comments, new followers. Analytics graph shows consistent posting and 4x engagement growth.
scenes.text_overlay: 80% time saved. Consistent brand presence.

scenes.visual: Cloud Insider logo with tagline. CTA button.
scenes.text_overlay:
Your brand stays active — even when you rest.

video_prompts.title: Invoice Chaos — Get Paid Faster, Chase Less
video_prompts.business_problem: Sending invoices one by one, chasing payments manually — cash flow bleeding

scenes.visual: A desk buried in paper invoices, printed spreadsheets with yellow highlighter marks. Sticky notes: 'FOLLOW UP - $2,400 overdue', 'CALL MR. AHMED - 3 weeks late'. The owner scrolls through WhatsApp looking for old invoice conversations. A calculator shows negative cash flow.
scenes.text_overlay: Chasing payments shouldn't be a full-time job.

scenes.visual: Montage: manually creating invoices in Word/Excel, copy-pasting client details, attaching PDFs to emails one by one, checking bank statements to match payments. A notification: 'Payment overdue — 45 days.' The owner sighs, picks up the phone to make another awkward follow-up call.
scenes.text_overlay: Manual invoicing. Manual follow-ups. Manual headaches.

scenes.visual: Transition to a clean automated invoice dashboard. AI auto-generates professional invoices on project completion. Invoices auto-sent via email and WhatsApp with payment links. A timeline shows: Day 1 — Invoice sent. Day 3 — Reminder sent automatically. Day 7 — Escalation email with late fee notice. Payment received — green checkmark. Cash flow graph rising steadily.
scenes.text_overlay: AI invoices. Auto-reminders. Instant payments.

scenes.visual: Dashboard showing: 'Average payment time: 3 days (was 23 days)'. Revenue graph climbing. The owner reviews a clean financial summary on a tablet, stress-free. Counter animates: '5x faster billing cycle.'
scenes.text_overlay: 5x faster billing. Zero awkward calls.

scenes.visual: Cloud Insider logo. CTA.
scenes.text_overlay:
Get paid faster. Chase less.

video_prompts.title: Cold Lead Waste — Stop Guessing, Start Closing
video_prompts.business_problem: No idea which leads are hot — sales team wastes time on cold prospects

scenes.visual: A sales team in action — one person calling lead after lead, getting voicemail. Another scrolling through a messy spreadsheet with 500+ contacts, all labeled 'new'. A whiteboard shows a funnel with a huge top and almost nothing at the bottom. Post-it: 'Close rate: 2%'.
scenes.text_overlay: 500 leads. 2% close rate. Something's broken.

scenes.visual: Close-up of the spreadsheet: no scoring, no priority, no follow-up dates. Sales rep cold-calling someone who already bought from a competitor. Another rep spending 30 minutes on a lead who has no budget. Time and money draining away.
scenes.text_overlay: Your sales team is guessing. Not selling.

scenes.visual: Transition to AI-powered CRM dashboard. Leads automatically scored — Hot (red flame icon), Warm (orange), Cold (blue snowflake). AI evaluates: website visits, email opens, form submissions, social interactions. Hot leads pushed to sales reps instantly via notification. Cold leads enter automated nurture email sequences. A pop-up: 'High-intent lead detected — Rafiq Trading — Visited pricing page 3x this week.'
scenes.text_overlay: AI scores every lead. Your team closes the right ones.

scenes.visual: Close rate counter animating: 2% → 4%. Revenue graph doubling. Sales team celebrating a big deal. Dashboard shows: 'This month: 24 deals closed (was 11).' The sales manager reviews the pipeline with confidence.
scenes.text_overlay: 2x conversion rate. Same team. Smarter system.

scenes.visual: Cloud Insider logo. CTA.
scenes.text_overlay:
Stop guessing. Start closing.
Cloud Insider — We Build What Lasts.

video_prompts.title: Support Inbox Meltdown — Let AI Handle the Repetitive
video_prompts.business_problem: Customer support inbox drowning — same questions asked over and over

scenes.visual: A support agent's screen — inbox showing 523 unread tickets. Subject lines repeating: 'Where is my order?', 'What's the return policy?', 'How do I reset my password?', 'Do you deliver to Chittagong?'. The agent is copy-pasting the same answer for the 50th time today. Dark circles under eyes. Coffee cups piling up.
scenes.text_overlay: 523 tickets. 80% are the same question.

scenes.visual: Customer review popup: '1 star — Nobody replied to my message for 3 days.' Another: 'Terrible support, switching to competitor.' CSAT score dropping: 4.2 → 3.1. The support manager stares at the declining graph.
scenes.text_overlay: Slow support = lost customers.

scenes.visual: Transition to an AI-powered Q&A bot interface. The bot is trained on the company's full knowledge base — product docs, FAQs, policies, order tracking. Customer asks 'Where is my order?' → Bot instantly pulls tracking info and responds with delivery date. Another asks 'Return policy?' → Bot sends the full policy with a return form link. All in under 2 seconds. Ticket queue counter dropping: 523 → 104.
scenes.text_overlay: AI trained on YOUR data. Answers instantly.

scenes.visual: Dashboard: '80% ticket reduction.' CSAT score climbing back: 3.1 → 4.7. The support agent now focuses on complex issues — actually helping real customers. Team morale up. Counter: '80% of support queries resolved by AI.'
scenes.text_overlay: 80% fewer tickets. Happier customers. Happier team.

scenes.visual: Cloud Insider logo. CTA.
scenes.text_overlay:
Let AI handle the repetitive. Your team handles the important.
Cloud Insider — We Build What Lasts.

video_prompts.title: Zero Conversions — Turn Visitors Into Customers Automatically
video_prompts.business_problem: Website gets traffic but no conversions — visitors leave without taking action

scenes.visual: Google Analytics dashboard: 10,000 visitors/month. But conversion counter: 12 leads. That's 0.12%. A heat map shows visitors landing on the homepage, scrolling halfway, and bouncing. Session recordings play: cursor hovers over pricing, then closes the tab. Money flying out the window (animated metaphor).
scenes.text_overlay: 10,000 visitors. 12 leads. Where's the leak?

scenes.visual: The business owner staring at ad spend reports: $2,000/month on Google Ads, $1,500 on Facebook Ads. Total: $3,500/month driving traffic — but almost nothing converting. A calculator shows: Cost per lead = $291. The owner shakes head in disbelief.
scenes.text_overlay: $3,500/month on ads. 12 leads. Do the math.

scenes.visual: Transition: An AI chatbot widget appears on the website's bottom-right corner. A visitor lands on the page — within 5 seconds, the bot greets them with a personalized message: 'Hi! Looking for [product]? I can help you find the perfect fit.' The visitor engages. Bot asks qualifying questions, captures email, recommends products, and books a demo call — all in 60 seconds. Smart exit-intent popup catches another visitor about to leave: 'Wait! Get 15% off your first order.' Email captured.
scenes.text_overlay: AI engages every visitor. Captures every lead.

scenes.visual: Dashboard transformation: Leads counter animates 12 → 200+. Cost per lead drops: $291 → $17.50. Conversion rate: 0.12% → 2%. The owner reviews a full pipeline of qualified leads on a CRM dashboard. Counter: '4x website leads.'
scenes.text_overlay: 4x more leads. Same traffic. Smarter conversion.

scenes.visual: Cloud Insider logo. CTA.
scenes.text_overlay:
Turn visitors into customers — automatically.
